sections.title: The Code Text
sections.legalText: The official text of the MedTech Europe Code of Ethical Business Practice is the PDF that MedTech Europe publishes on its website. This app reproduces it for easier reading, with a few editorial corrections. If the two differ, the PDF prevails.

sections.title: Using the App’s Tools
sections.legalText:
The decision trees, the Conference Vetting System check, “Can we support this event?”, the TPPT Checker and the Knowledge Quiz help you apply the Code. They are guidance: they are not legal advice, they do not replace the text of the Code, and they are not decisions of the Conference Vetting System.

As far as the law allows, MedTech Europe is not liable for decisions taken on the basis of their answers.
